test_title: PYST 5: SSC CGL 2022 - General Awareness(Held On: 02 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following becomes the first district in India to cover 100% households under ABPMJAY- SEHAT scheme?
solution: The correct answer is Samba, Jammu and Kashmir. Samba, Jammu and Kashmir becomes the first district in India to cover 100% of households under the ABPMJAY- SEHAT scheme.PM launched the Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY) SEHAT scheme for the residents of Jammu and Kashmir.
